metaDescription: Follow EPM, a 1:1 Minecraft recreation of Europa-Park.

home.title: Europa-Park, at a 1:1 scale.
home.lead: EPM is a Minecraft recreation of Europa-Park. The project is being built; find confirmed information and upcoming updates here.
home.visualCaption: The park takes shape, block by block.
home.sectionText: EPM aims to recreate the park at a 1:1 scale. Details about its areas and builds will be added once confirmed.
home.galleryText: The first screenshots will be added here when they are available.

project.title: The EPM project
project.intro: Europa-Park Minecraft (EPM) is a project to recreate the park in Minecraft. The information below is limited to confirmed facts.
project.noteText: Details about the team, organisation and different areas will be shared once confirmed.

park.title: The park
park.intro: The recreation is under construction. Names and details of areas and attractions will be added once confirmed.
park.zonesText: This list includes the 106 entries found in Europa-Park’s official German catalogue on 29 October 2026. The catalogue covers different kinds of experiences, not only rides. Names are kept in their official German form. Attractions are not grouped by themed area where that association could not be verified. The status below refers to the EPM recreation.
park.galleryText: Project screenshots added to the site appear here. Select an image to enlarge it.

progress.title: Progress
progress.intro: The park is being built and the server is in development. No percentages or schedule are published without confirmed information.
progress.newsText: Updates will be posted here when available.
progress.newsEmpty: No news yet. The next update will appear here.

team.title: Team and recruitment
team.intro: Information about team members will be added once confirmed.
team.recruitmentText: Recruitment information will be shared here once it has been defined.

server.title: The server
server.intro: The server is in development. There is no public IP address to share yet.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Have a question for the EPM team? Send a message using the form.
contact.consentText: I agree that my Discord username and message may be sent to the EPM team via Discord to respond to my enquiry.
contact.privacyNote: Do not include sensitive information in your message.
contact.successMessage: Message sent. Thanks for getting in touch.
contact.errorGeneric: Your message could not be sent. Please try again later.
contact.errorNotConfigured: The contact form is not configured yet. Please try again later.
contact.errorInvalid: The username and subject must contain at least 2 characters, and the message at least 5.
contact.errorRateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a while before trying again.
contact.errorUpstream: Message delivery failed. Please try again later.

footer.fanNotice: EPM is an independent, unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Europa-Park.
